meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，容器内每次通过 Bash 工具执行命令，都会先经 rtk 代理。rtk 会压缩 git、cargo、pytest、docker 等常用开发命令的输出，据称可节省 60–90% 的 token；无需再写 CLAUDE.md 配置。
howto.when: 当容器内通过 Bash 工具执行命令时触发；例如运行 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令，输出会先被 rtk 拦截处理。

say.text: 运行 git status 看下当前工作区状态。
say.note: 该命令输出会经过 rtk 压缩后返回。

say.text: 执行 cargo build 编译一下项目。
say.note: Bash 调用会被 rtk 拦截过滤。

say.text: 跑一次 pytest，告诉我测试结果。
say.note: 命令执行会走 rtk 代理链路。

howto.what_en: After install, every Bash tool call in the container is routed through rtk, which compresses output for common dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, etc.) to save 60–90% tokens. No CLAUDE.md instruction is needed.
howto.when_en: It triggers whenever a Bash tool call happens inside the container; for example, git, cargo, pytest commands are passed through the rtk hook.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the current state.
Run cargo build to compile the project.
Run pytest and tell me the results.
say_en.note: Command goes through the rtk proxy.
